column1: # hostname acceptance vectors, from RFC 1123 §2.1 and the DNS name rules it
# The official suite's optional/format/hostname.json carries 55 string cases
# covering the label character rules, the 63-octet cap, and a long set of
# A-labels. What it leaves open is the numeric top-level ban, the trailing-dot
# FQDN, the plain reserved-LDH label, and the exact 253-octet boundary, which
# the suite only approaches with a 259-character rejection. The remaining rows
# restate a suite case, kept so the label rules read whole in one place.
# Row format: see loadVectorFile in vectors_test.go.
